Using suitable pairings and mode insertions, we derive bilinear differential equations for weighted sums of products of Virasoro irregular conformal blocks of types $(0,0,1)$ and $(0,2)$. After explicit parameter identifications and a gauge transformation in the Painlevé V case, the resulting bilinear differential operators agree with those appearing in the quantum Painlevé V and IV tau-function equations.
summary: 我们将 Neveu-Schwarz 代数的零秩不规则顶点算子构造为满足通常的超共形交换关系和不规则渐近条件的相同秩的不规则 Verma 模块之间的线性映射。在非简并假设$\Lambda_{2p}\neq0$下，我们证明了它们的存在性和唯一性。然后，我们将 Neveu-Schwarz 代数的分解定理扩展到不规则设置：自由费米子 Fock 模块与阶 $p$ Neveu-Schwarz 不规则 Verma 模块的张量积分解为两个 Virasoro 不规则 Verma 模块的张量积的无限直和。我们还证明了不规则顶点算子到 Virasoro 不规则顶点算子的张量积的兼容分解。使用合适的配对和模式插入，我们推导出 $(0,0,1)$ 和 $(0,2)$ 类型的 Virasoro 不规则共形块的乘积加权和的双线性微分方程。在 Painlevé V 情况下进行显式参数识别和规范变换后，所得双线性微分算子与量子 Painlevé V 和 IV tau 函数方程中出现的结果一致。

title: From Lie--Rinehart Algebras to $F$-Manifold Algebras
abstract: For every Lie--Rinehart algebra, we construct an $F$-manifold algebra on the direct sum of its base algebra and module. Contrary to the assertion in \cite[Proposition 13.3.26]{LodayVallette}, the resulting structure is generally not Poisson. We determine when powers of the positive-degree ideal in the associated symmetric Poisson algebra are Poisson ideals, and relate the Leibnizator to the Lie--Rinehart differential. For a finite projective module of constant rank, the trace of the Leibnizator recovers the anchor and yields a rigidity result for injective anchors. We conclude with algebraic and geometric examples.
summary: 对于每个李-莱因哈特代数，我们在其基代数和模的直和上构造一个 $F$ 流形代数。与 \cite[Proposition 13.3.26]{LodayVallette} 中的断言相反，所得结构通常不是泊松结构。我们确定相关对称泊松代数中正次数理想的幂何时是泊松理想，并将莱布尼化器与李-莱因哈特微分联系起来。对于恒定秩的有限射影模，莱布尼化器的迹恢复锚点并产生射射锚点的刚性结果。我们以代数和几何例子作为结论。

title: A discrete Smorodinsky--Winternitz I superintegrable system
abstract: We construct a finite discrete realization of the Smorodinsky--Winternitz I superintegrable system on a triangular region of the two-dimensional square lattice. The construction is based on a pair of commuting number operators with finite spectrum together with an associated ladder-operator structure. We show that the resulting model is maximally superintegrable and that its symmetry algebra admits a Hahn-algebra presentation. Its spectral problem is solved exactly in terms of the bivariate dual Hahn polynomials of Tratnik type. Finally, we show that the continuum limit recovers the continuous Smorodinsky--Winternitz I system together with its ladder operators, eigenfunctions and symmetry algebra, thereby establishing the present construction as a genuine finite discrete realization of the continuous model.
summary: 我们在二维方格的三角形区域上构造了 Smorodinsky-Winternitz I 超可积系统的有限离散实现。该结构基于一对具有有限频谱的通勤号码运算符以及相关的梯形运算符结构。我们证明了所得模型是最大超可积的，并且其对称代数允许哈恩代数表示。其谱问题可以根据 Tratnik 类型的二元对偶 Hahn 多项式精确求解。最后，我们证明连续统极限可以恢复连续的 Smorodinsky-Winternitz I 系统及其梯子算子、本征函数和对称代数，从而将当前的结构建立为连续模型的真正有限离散实现。

title: Notes on Electrostatics in $\mathbb R^3$
abstract: A compact formulation of electrostatics is presented. Without using constitutive relations, including the aether relations, an expression for the potential energy of a charged region under a potential function is proposed, where the charge distribution is specified by the charge potential field. Assuming that during a virtual motion of the charge, the virtual work expended by the field is equal to minus the time derivative of the potential energy, an expression for the mechanical force functional is derived. The force functional contains the action of an asymmetric active stress field D_{i}E_{j}, the skew-symmetric part of which is the mechanical couple density.
summary: 提出了静电学的紧凑公式。在不使用包括以太关系在内的本构关系的情况下，提出了势函数下带电区域的势能表达式，其中电荷分布由电荷势场指定。假设电荷在虚运动过程中，场所消耗的虚功等于减去势能的时间导数，则推导出机械力泛函的表达式。力泛函包含不对称主动应力场 D_{i}E_{j} 的作用，其斜对称部分是机械偶密度。

title: A discrete Smorodinsky--Winternitz II superintegrable system
abstract: We construct a discrete Smorodinsky--Winternitz II superintegrable system on a triangular region of the two-dimensional square lattice. The model is built from a pair of commuting finite-difference number operators with finite spectrum together with an associated ladder-operator structure. We show that it is maximally superintegrable and that its symmetry algebra admits a Hahn-algebra presentation. The spectral problem is solved exactly in terms of bivariate orthogonal polynomials of mixed Krawtchouk and dual Hahn type associated with the factorized $A_2$-Leonard pair. Finally, we show that the continuum limit recovers the continuous Smorodinsky--Winternitz II system together with its Hermite--Laguerre eigenfunctions. We further explain how the Hahn presentation of the discrete symmetry algebra becomes singular in this limit, while the limiting algebraic structure is naturally described by the Laguerre--Heun algebra associated with Cartesian and parabolic separation of variables.
summary: 我们在二维方格的三角形区域上构造了一个离散的Smorodinsky-Winternitz II超可积系统。该模型是由一对具有有限谱的可交换有限差分数算子以及相关的梯形算子结构构建的。我们证明它是最大超可积的，并且它的对称代数允许哈恩代数表示。谱问题可以根据与因式分解 $A_2$-Leonard 对相关的混合 Krawtchouk 和对偶 Hahn 类型的二元正交多项式精确求解。最后，我们证明连续统极限可以恢复连续的 Smorodinsky-Winternitz II 系统及其 Hermite-Laguerre 特征函数。我们进一步解释了离散对称代数的哈恩表示如何在此极限下变得奇异，而极限代数结构自然地由与笛卡尔和抛物线分离变量相关的拉盖尔-赫恩代数描述。

title: Transparent Boundary Conditions for the Heat Equation on Metric Graphs
abstract: We study transparent boundary conditions (TBCs) for the time-dependent heat equation in a branching, quasi-one-dimensional domain modeled as a metric star graph. By combining the classical concept of TBCs with the theory of partial differential equations (PDEs) on networks, we derive an exact vertex condition that ensures unobstructed thermal flow across junctions. Specifically,we derive a sum rule for the diffusion coefficients that eliminates thermal backflow at the this http URL demonstrate the validity of this analytical model numerically using a Crank-Nicolson finite-difference method, which confirms smooth, unobstructed heat propagation through the this http URL results provide a practical mathematical framework for tunable control and optimization of thermal diffusion in low-dimensional structures. In particular, combining the well-known concept of the TBCs and theory for PDE on metric graphs, we propose a mathematical model providing a control tool for thermal diffusion in networks.
summary: 我们研究了建模为度量星图的分支准一维域中瞬态热方程的透明边界条件 (TBC)。通过将 TBC 的经典概念与网络偏微分方程 (PDE) 理论相结合，我们得出了精确的顶点条件，确保热流在结点上畅通无阻。具体来说，我们导出了消除此 http URL 处的热回流的扩散系数的求和规则，并使用 Crank-Nicolson 有限差分法以数值方式证明了该分析模型的有效性，该方法证实了通过此 http URL 结果的平滑、无阻碍的热传播，为低维结构中热扩散的可调控制和优化提供了实用的数学框架。特别是，结合众所周知的 TBC 概念和度量图上的 PDE 理论，我们提出了一种数学模型，为网络中的热扩散提供了控制工具。

title: Exact analytical solution for the non-selfadjoint problem of Maxwell--Cattaneo--Vernotte heat conduction with heat-transfer boundary condition
abstract: The most well-known beyond-Fourier heat conduction model, the Maxwell--Cattaneo--Vernotte equation is solved analytically in the presence of heat transfer boundary condition. In contrast to the corresponding Fourier problem, this boundary condition renders the underlying differential operator non-selfadjoint. With a suitable scalar product, the adjoint eigenvalue problem is established. The resulting left and right eigenfunctions constitute a biorthogonal system, allowing the expansion coefficients to be determined from arbitrary square-integrable initial conditions. This enables a convenient infinite-sum analytical solution, which is presented and thoroughly investigated for various values of the model parameters (including near-Fourier and highly hyperbolic regimes) and for two practically important initial conditions (equilibrium and flash pulse initiated). The spectral structure is analyzed in detail, including the occurrence of real, imaginary, and complex-conjugate eigenvalue roots, their asymptotic distribution, and their dependence on the dimensionless relaxation time and Biot number. We find good agreement with corresponding finite-difference numerical solutions. The comparison also illustrates the effects of spectral truncation (i.e., the Gibbs phenomenon) and numerical dissipation near propagating thermal-wave fronts. Completeness of the eigenfunction set is numerically demonstrated. The initial condition induced by the flash pulse is derived analytically. The results provide an analytical benchmark for non-selfadjoint hyperbolic heat conduction, unveil how boundary heat transfer and relaxation time influence the transition between Fourier-like diffusion and thermal-wave propagation, and open the possibility to find and investigate beyond-Fourier heat conduction via heat transfer in experiments and practical applications.
summary:
最著名的超傅立叶热传导模型麦克斯韦-卡塔内奥-维诺特方程在存在传热边界条件的情况下进行解析求解。与相应的傅立叶问题相反，该边界条件使底层微分算子成为非自共轭的。通过合适的标量积，建立了伴随特征值问题。由此产生的左和右本征函数构成双正交系统，允许根据任意平方可积初始条件确定展开系数。这实现了方便的无限和分析解决方案，该解决方案针对模型参数的各种值（包括近傅立叶和高度双曲区域）和两个实际重要的初始条件（平衡和启动的闪光脉冲）进行了呈现和彻底研究。详细分析了谱结构，包括实部、虚部和复共轭特征值根的出现、它们的渐近分布以及它们对无量纲弛豫时间和毕奥数的依赖性。我们发现与相应的有限差分数值解有很好的一致性。

该比较还说明了光谱截断（即吉布斯现象）和传播热波前附近的数值耗散的影响。数值证明了本征函数集的完整性。分析得出由闪光脉冲引起的初始条件。研究结果为非自伴双曲线热传导提供了分析基准，揭示了边界传热和弛豫时间如何影响类傅里叶扩散和热波传播之间的转变，并为在实验和实际应用中通过传热发现和研究超傅里叶热传导提供了可能性。

title: On Toeplitz determinants with slow Fourier decay
abstract: We study Toeplitz determinants $\det T_n(e^f)$ for $f$ whose Fourier coefficients satisfy $f_k=O(|k|^{-1})$. This regime extends beyond $H^{1/2}$ and includes symbols with Fisher-Hartwig singularities. We develop an operator-theoretic approach based on the Baker-Campbell-Hausdorff formula that separates the quadratic term \[ \sum_{k=1}^{\infty}\min(k,n)f_kf_{-k} \] from the higher-order terms in the expansion of $\log\det T_n(e^{tf})$. We show that this quadratic term accounts for the possible growth with $n$, while every fixed higher-order coefficient remains bounded. For symbols with bounded positive and negative Fourier parts, our estimates yield two-sided bounds for the determinant after removal of the quadratic contribution. For a broader admissible class, including Fisher-Hartwig-type symbols, we obtain uniform higher-order coefficient bounds and a central limit theorem for the associated CUE linear statistics. We also obtain bounds on mixed exponential moments for CUE-derived random fields beyond the characteristic polynomial.
summary: 我们研究 $f$ 的托普利茨行列式 $\det T_n(e^f)$，其傅立叶系数满足 $f_k=O(|k|^{-1})$。该机制超出了 $H^{1/2}$ 范围，并包括具有 Fisher-Hartwig 奇点的符号。我们开发了一种基于 Baker-Campbell-Hausdorff 公式的算子理论方法，该方法将二次项 \[ \sum_{k=1}^{\infty}\min(k,n)f_kf_{-k} \] 与 $\log\det T_n(e^{tf})$ 展开中的高阶项分开。我们证明这个二次项解释了 $n$ 可能的增长，而每个固定的高阶系数仍然有界。对于具有有界正傅立叶部分和负傅立叶部分的符号，我们的估计在去除二次贡献后产生行列式的两侧界限。对于更广泛的可接受类别，包括 Fisher-Hartwig 型符号，我们获得了统一的高阶系数界限和相关 CUE 线性统计的中心极限定理。我们还获得了 CUE 导出的随机场超出特征多项式的混合指数矩的界限。

title: Proper condensates and the Onsager-Penrose condition: A friendly debate on Bose-Einstein condensation
abstract: This article contrasts the concepts of a proper condensate and the Onsager-Penrose criterion for Bose-Einstein condensation in the form of a debate between two proponents of the respective concepts. The prologue briefly introduces the two criteria. The epilogue contains remarks on properties of the underlying resolvent algebra that are physically relevant in this context.
summary: 本文以各自概念的两位支持者之间辩论的形式，对比了真凝聚的概念和玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚的 Onsager-Penrose 准则。序言简要介绍了这两个标准。尾声包含对与本文物理相关的基础解析代数属性的评论。

title: Hidden Dyson Universality in Inverse-Spectral Geometry
abstract: Dyson universality typically manifests itself in local eigenvalue statistics. Here we show that its signature survives a nonlinear inverse-spectral reconstruction and reappears in the matrix geometry of the reconstructed operator. Using a dressing transformation, we map each unfolded spectrum to a deformation $f(x)$ of a fixed harmonic oscillator and represent it in the common oscillator basis by $F_{mn}=\bra m|f|n\ket$. We resolve the matrix-element weight into shells of fixed distance $d=|m-n|$, corresponding to the energy-transfer channels of the reference oscillator, and characterize the resulting distribution by distance-shell moments. Independently calibrated on Gaussian $\beta$-ensembles, these moments vary smoothly with $\beta$ and distinguish the GOE, GUE, and GSE. With this calibration fixed, applying the same diagnostic to the nontrivial zeros of the Riemann zeta function places the reconstructed operators in the GUE sector. Thus, the GUE character of the zeros is recovered not through direct statistics of the input levels, but from the distance-resolved geometry of the reconstructed operator.
summary: 戴森普适性通常体现在局部特征值统计中。在这里，我们展示了它的签名在非线性逆谱重建中幸存下来并重新出现在重建算子的矩阵几何中。使用修整变换，我们将每个展开频谱映射到固定谐振子的变形 $f(x)$，并在公共振荡器基础中用 $F_{mn}=\bra m|f|n\ket$ 表示它。我们将矩阵元素权重解析为固定距离 $d=|m-n|$ 的壳，对应于参考振荡器的能量传递通道，并通过距离壳矩来表征所得分布。在高斯 $\beta$ 系综上独立校准，这些矩随 $\beta$ 平滑变化，并区分 GOE、GUE 和 GSE。固定此校准后，对黎曼 zeta 函数的非平凡零点应用相同的诊断会将重构算子置于 GUE 扇区中。因此，零点的 GUE 特征不是通过输入电平的直接统计来恢复的，而是通过重构算子的距离解析几何来恢复的。

title: Symmetry Emergence in Self-Organized Criticality
abstract: We describe a mechanism of affine symmetry emergence in the maximal density regime of the prototypical model of self-organized criticality when the inverse square of the mesh of the underlying lattice is much larger than the number of random perturbation points distributed according to a prescribed probability measure supported in the interior of the ambient convex domain. Moreover, an appropriate scaling limit of the toppling function (aka odometer), which counts the number of operations per site, is a solution to a non-linear partial differential equation well known in the context of optimal transport and differential geometry, making it possible to accurately estimate the deviation of the density from its maximal value in any macroscopic window. The mechanism for the affine symmetry emergence is due to the novel empirical fact, supported in addition by inductive arguments that have recently being upgraded to a rigorous proof, that the scaling limit of the toppling function is the unique concave solution of the Monge-Ampère equation with Dirichlet boundary condition on the convex domain with the potential given by the probability measure used above as the infinite-perturbation profile.
summary:
我们描述了当基础晶格的网格的平方反比远大于根据环境凸域内部支持的规定概率度量分布的随机扰动点的数量时，自组织临界性原型模型的最大密度域中仿射对称出现的机制。此外，倾倒函数（又名里程计）的适当缩放限制（计算每个站点的操作数量）是最优传输和微分几何背景下众所周知的非线性偏微分方程的解，使得可以准确估计任何宏观窗口中密度与其最大值的偏差。

仿射对称出现的机制归因于新颖的经验事实，此外还受到最近升级为严格证明的归纳论证的支持，即倾倒函数的标度极限是凸域上具有狄利克雷边界条件的 Monge-Ampère 方程的唯一凹解，其势由上面用作无限扰动轮廓的概率测度给出。

title: Embedding Stabilizer Codes and Leakage Correction in Multilevel Quantum Systems
abstract: Leakage beyond the computational subspace is a major source of error in multilevel quantum hardware. We show that any \( [[n,k,d]] \) stabilizer code can be embedded isometrically into a single \(D\)-dimensional system while preserving its complete error-correcting structure. We further derive a necessary and sufficient condition for exact leakage correction, proving that leakage is correctable precisely when it does not distinguish between logical states. These results establish a unified framework for quantum error correction in multilevel quantum systems.
summary: 计算子空间之外的泄漏是多级量子硬件中的主要错误来源。我们证明任何\([[n,k,d]]\)稳定器代码都可以等距嵌入到单个\(D\)维系统中，同时保留其完整的纠错结构。我们进一步推导了精确泄漏校正的充分必要条件，证明当泄漏不区分逻辑状态时，泄漏是可精确校正的。这些结果为多级量子系统中的量子纠错建立了统一的框架。

title: Spatially Dense, Continuous-Variable Quantum Computing with Solid State Spin Nonlinearities
abstract: Nanomechanical structures have been investigated as a method of achieving long-lived quantum excitations at radio frequencies. Their high quality factors are especially intriguing as a medium for bosonic encoding of quantum information. However, to leading order, mechanical modes typically lack the nonlinearities necessary to achieve interaction between bosonic channels and thus are limited in their ability to scale to the many-qubit regime necessary for practical quantum computing. In this work, we propose and describe an approach for bosonic quantum information processing that uses strain-sensitive solid-state spins as nonlinear elements to produce the relevant nonclassical mechanical states. We outline the architecture required to achieve nearest-neighbor connectivity between mechanical cat-state qubits on-chip, as well as the control and readout architecture required for universal quantum computation. In addition, we show that this architecture can allow for a high spatial density of logical qubits by leveraging both the efficiency of bosonic error correction schemes and the small sizes of the constituent nanomechanical resonators and spin qubits. Finally, we identify the necessary performance metrics that will enable error-correction thresholds at high qubit densities, illuminating a path towards scalable quantum information processing.
summary:
纳米机械结构已被研究为一种在射频下实现长寿命量子激发的方法。作为量子信息玻色编码的媒介，它们的高质量因子尤其令人感兴趣。然而，对于先导阶，机械模式通常缺乏实现玻色子通道之间相互作用所需的非线性，因此其扩展到实际量子计算所需的多量子位机制的能力受到限制。在这项工作中，我们提出并描述了一种玻色子量子信息处理方法，该方法使用应变敏感的固态自旋作为非线性元素来产生相关的非经典力学状态。我们概述了在片上机械猫态量子位之间实现最近邻连接所需的架构，以及通用量子计算所需的控制和读出架构。此外，我们还表明，这种架构可以通过利用玻色子纠错方案的效率以及组成纳米机械谐振器和自旋量子位的小尺寸来实现逻辑量子位的高空间密度。

最后，我们确定了必要的性能指标，这些指标将在高量子位密度下实现纠错阈值，从而阐明通往可扩展量子信息处理的道路。

title: Quantum Tanner Codes at Moderate Blocklength
abstract: We present explicit constructions of quantum Tanner (QT) codes with good rate and distance, obtained through two complementary approaches: the left-right Cayley complex (LRCC) description and the "lifting" perspective, in which a seed Calderbank-Shor-Steane (CSS) code is lifted by commuting left-right regular actions of a finite group $\mathcal{G}$. Through an extensive search over non-abelian groups from GAP's SmallGrp library, we investigate the moderate-blocklength regime ($n \in [500,1000]$) and identify several new code instances with distance upper bounds exceeding $20$. These include $[[480,8,(\leq 21,\leq 21)]]$, $[[504,4,(\leq 36,\leq 27)]]$, $[[672,4,(\leq 48,\leq 28)]]$, $[[720,6,(\leq 30,\leq 30)]]$, and $[[864,8,(\leq 39,\leq 31)]]$, with these bounds obtained using up to $350$ million trials of sQetch, a randomized distance estimator. The code instances presented have check weights ranging from $9$ to $20$. Using the Tesseract decoder, we estimate pseudo-thresholds of $3.6\%$-$4.6\%$ under phenomenological noise and $0.14\%$-$0.27\%$ under circuit-level noise, comparable to prior results at shorter code lengths. We also provide this http URL , an open-source Julia library for constructing QT codes and explicit constructions of Ramanujan graphs.
summary:
我们提出了具有良好速率和距离的量子 Tanner (QT) 码的显式构造，通过两种互补的方法获得：左右凯莱复数 (LRCC) 描述和“提升”视角，其中通过交换有限群 $\mathcal{G}$ 的左右正则动作来提升种子 Calderbank-Shor-Steane (CSS) 码。通过对 GAP SmallGrp 库中的非交换群进行广泛搜索，我们研究了中等块长度机制（$n \in [500,1000]$），并识别了几个距离上限超过 $20$ 的新代码实例。其中包括 $[[480,8,(\leq 21,\leq 21)]]$、$[[504,4,(\leq 36,\leq 27)]]$、$[[672,4,(\leq 48,\leq 28)]]$、$[[720,6,(\leq 30,\leq 30)]]$ 和$[[864,8,(\leq 39,\leq 31)]]$，这些界限是通过对随机距离估计器 sQetch 进行高达 3.5 亿美元的试验而获得的。所提供的代码实例的检查权重范围为 $9$ 到 $20$。使用 Tesseract 解码器，我们估计现象学噪声下的伪阈值为 $3.6\%$-$4.6\%$ 和电路级噪声下的 $0.14\%$-$0.27\%$，与之前在较短代码长度下的结果相当。

我们还提供了这个 http URL ，这是一个开源 Julia 库，用于构建 QT 代码和显式构建 Ramanujan 图。

title: Pulse Engineering of Quantum Many-Body Dynamics: Emergent Scar States, Entanglement, and Nonstabilizerness
abstract: Understanding and coherently controlling the properties of interacting quantum many-body systems is a central challenge in non-equilibrium quantum physics. While in the past decades, a wide range of many-body Hamiltonians have been introduced to study quantum chaos, atypical eigenstates, and quantum resources, systematically engineering and continuously tuning these properties within a single microscopic model remains largely unexplored. Here, we employ a pulse engineering scheme to construct an effective Hamiltonian that continuously interpolates between a chaotic Heisenberg (XXX) chain with a local impurity and the ZX Hamiltonian. Along this interpolation, we identify several families of analytically tractable atypical eigenstates embedded in the excited-state spectrum with distinct entanglement and nonstabilizerness properties. In the XXX limit, these states exhibit exact plateaus in both entanglement and stabilizer Rényi entropy and correspond to coherent superpositions of long-range valence-bond solid (VBS) states. As the pulse strength increases, the effective Hamiltonians exhibit a hierarchy of new set of approximate entanglement plateaus in the low-energy spectrum. Interestingly, in the fully pulse-engineered ZX limit, we uncover a distinct pair of long-range entangled stabilizer eigenstates, corresponding to rainbow scar states. We further show that pulse engineering preserves the distinct chaotic and non-chaotic regimes of the original model, while that is largely absent in the dynamical generation of entanglement and nonstabilizerness. The pulse-engineered models generate nearly identical quantum resources in both regimes, revealing a partial decoupling between quantum chaos and quantum-resource generation. Our results establish pulse engineering as a versatile framework for generating many-body Hamiltonians with structured eigenstates and tunable quantum resources.
summary:
理解和连贯地控制相互作用的量子多体系统的特性是非平衡量子物理学的一个核心挑战。虽然在过去的几十年里，人们广泛引入了多体哈密顿量来研究量子混沌、非典型本征态和量子资源，但在单个微观模型中系统地设计和不断调整这些特性仍然很大程度上未被探索。在这里，我们采用脉冲工程方案来构建有效的哈密顿量，该哈密顿量在具有局部杂质的混沌海森堡（XXX）链和 ZX 哈密顿量之间连续插值。沿着这种插值，我们识别出嵌入激发态光谱中的几个可分析处理的非典型本征态家族，具有独特的纠缠和非稳定特性。在 XXX 极限下，这些态在纠缠和稳定器 Rényi 熵方面都表现出精确的平台，并且对应于长程价键固体 (VBS) 态的相干叠加。随着脉冲强度的增加，有效哈密顿量在低能谱中表现出一组新的近似纠缠平台的层次结构。

有趣的是，在完全脉冲设计的 ZX 极限中，我们发现了一对独特的长程纠缠稳定剂本征态，对应于彩虹疤痕态。我们进一步表明，脉冲工程保留了原始模型的独特混沌和非混沌状态，而这在纠缠和非稳定器的动态生成中很大程度上不存在。脉冲工程模型在两种状态下生成几乎相同的量子资源，揭示了量子混沌和量子资源生成之间的部分解耦。我们的结果将脉冲工程确立为一种通用框架，用于生成具有结构化本征态和可调量子资源的多体哈密顿量。

title: Two-atom Dicke model with atom-atom interaction
abstract: Interactions among emitters provide a powerful means of controlling collective light--matter phenomena, yet their role in superradiant criticality has not been thoroughly investigated. Here we construct a minimal model that can yield analytical insights --- a Dicke model with two interacting atoms coupled to a single mode cavity --- to study such interaction effects. We show that interaction changes the phase boundary, and may even completely suppress the atom-photon coupling threshold for superradiance and change the universality class of the phase transition. We further study the dissipative phase transition and quantum dynamics in the presence of dissipation channels such as photon loss and spin relaxation. Our results demonstrate important roles played by the atom-atom interaction and how it can be engineered to control atom-photon coupling.
summary: 发射体之间的相互作用提供了控制集体光物质现象的强大手段，但它们在超辐射临界性中的作用尚未得到彻底研究。在这里，我们构建了一个可以产生分析见解的最小模型——两个相互作用的原子耦合到单模腔的迪克模型——来研究这种相互作用效应。我们证明相互作用改变了相界，甚至可能完全抑制超辐射的原子-光子耦合阈值并改变相变的普遍性类别。我们进一步研究存在耗散通道（例如光子损失和自旋弛豫）的情况下的耗散相变和量子动力学。我们的结果证明了原子-原子相互作用所发挥的重要作用以及如何设计它来控制原子-光子耦合。

title: Free-Space Quantum Networks and Optimized Fiber-Reinforcement
abstract: Free-space quantum communication provides a flexible complement to fiber-based quantum networks, but its point-to-point capacity is fundamentally limited by diffraction, atmospheric extinction and beam wandering induced by turbulence. In this work, we study the end-to-end performance of large-scale free-space quantum networks connecting randomly distributed fixed or mobile users, modelled as Waxman random graphs. We derive the mean network capacity, edge consumption and connectivity phase transitions for both single-path and multi-path (flooding) routing. We also study router-centered star networks, deriving the full distribution of end-to-end capacities as a function of the router's coverage radius. We then consider how performance may be improved by reinforcing free-space networks with a small number of optimally placed fiber-based backbone nodes. We prove that any optimal backbone configuration must correspond to a capacity-maximizing Voronoi tessellation of the network region, and show that this can be efficiently approximated by a centroidal Voronoi tessellation via Lloyd's algorithm, with backbone nodes connected according to a Delaunay triangulation. Numerical results show that even a modest number of backbone nodes substantially improves end-to-end capacity and reduces edge consumption for both mobile and fixed users.
summary:
自由空间量子通信为基于光纤的量子网络提供了灵活的补充，但其点对点容量从根本上受到衍射、大气消光和湍流引起的光束漂移的限制。在这项工作中，我们研究了连接随机分布的固定或移动用户的大规模自由空间量子网络的端到端性能，建模为 Waxman 随机图。我们得出单路径和多路径（洪泛）路由的平均网络容量、边缘消耗和连接相变。我们还研究以路由器为中心的星形网络，得出端到端容量的完整分布作为路由器覆盖半径的函数。然后，我们考虑如何通过使用少量优化放置的基于光纤的骨干节点来增强自由空间网络来提高性能。我们证明任何最佳骨干配置必须对应于网络区域的容量最大化 Voronoi 细分，并表明这可以通过劳埃德算法通过质心 Voronoi 细分来有效地近似，骨干节点根据 Delaunay 三角剖分连接。

数值结果表明，即使骨干节点数量适中，也可以显着提高移动和固定用户的端到端容量并减少边缘消耗。

title: Topological State-Aware Simulation Framework for Inter-Satellite Twin-Field QKD Networks
abstract: Inter-satellite links (ISLs) are the mandatory backbone for global quantum networks. While Twin-Field Quantum Key Distribution (TF-QKD) successfully surpasses linear rate-loss bounds, its extreme phase sensitivity makes it highly vulnerable to dynamic, non-IID (Independent and Identically Distributed) orbital environments. In composable finite-key analyses governed by the Generalized Entropy Accumulation Theorem (GEAT), traditional adaptive post-selection heuristics either violate strict independence conditions or incur massive second-order penalties that collapse the secret key rate. To overcome this, we introduce a reference-only topological post-selection oracle. By modeling the constellation as a Cellular Sheaf and applying Topological Data Analysis (TDA), our protocol derives a public acceptance event ($\Omega$) exclusively from classical beacon telemetry. To rigorously validate this mechanism, we develop a modular simulation framework equipped with stochastic noise injection and an explicit GEAT security ledger. Simulations across 2,000-5,000 km ISL separations compare the same Hodge-Koopman gate with TDA disabled and enabled. At 2,000 km, the median conditional candidate rates are $2.14 \times 10^{-6}$ and $5.87 \times 10^{-7}$ bit per emitted pulse, respectively; both configurations return zero at 3,000-5,000 km. TDA is active in all 4,788 evaluated windows, but does not extend the positive-candidate range in this scenario. These exported rates are conditional numerical candidates: the full protocol-level composable-security proof remains incomplete and the certified composable rate is therefore zero throughout.
summary:
卫星间链路（ISL）是全球量子网络的强制性骨干网。虽然双场量子密钥分配 (TF-QKD) 成功超越了线性速率损失界限，但其极端的相位敏感性使其极易受到动态、非 IID（独立同分布）轨道环境的影响。在由广义熵累积定理 (GEAT) 控制的可组合有限密钥分析中，传统的自适应后选择启发式要么违反严格的独立条件，要么招致大量二阶惩罚，导致密钥率崩溃。为了克服这个问题，我们引入了一个仅供参考的拓扑后选择预言机。通过将星座建模为细胞束并应用拓扑数据分析（TDA），我们的协议仅从经典信标遥测中导出公共接受事件（$\Omega$）。为了严格验证这一机制，我们开发了一个配备随机噪声注入和显式 GEAT 安全账本的模块化模拟框架。跨 2,000-5,000 公里 ISL 间隔的模拟比较了禁用和启用 TDA 的相同 Hodge-Koopman 门。

在 2,000 公里处，每个发射脉冲的条件候选速率中位数分别为 $2.14 \times 10^{-6}$ 和 $5.87 \times 10^{-7}$ 位；两种配置都会在 3,000-5,000 公里时归零。 TDA 在所有 4,788 个评估窗口中均处于活动状态，但在这种情况下不会扩展正候选范围。这些导出的速率是有条件的数字候选：完整的协议级可组合安全证明仍然不完整，因此经过认证的可组合速率始终为零。

title: SPLIT-Q: A Scalable Sequential Quantum Computing Framework for Coherent Controlled Islanding
abstract: Growing integration of distributed energy resources increases power-system variability and uncertainty. During disturbances, these effects can intensify generation-load imbalances and cascading failures. Controlled islanding limits their propagation by partitioning a compromised grid into connected, electrically sustainable islands. However, classical methods face rapidly growing computational costs as network size and island count increase. Quantum optimization offers an alternative for exploring this combinatorial partition space. Yet monolithic quantum formulations encode all assignment decisions in one circuit, causing qubit demand and circuit complexity to scale with network size. In this study, a qubit-bounded sequential distributed quantum approximate optimization algorithm (QAOA) framework is proposed to tackle coherent controlled islanding under limited quantum resources. It formulates the optimization as boundary-conditioned regional quadratic unconstrained binary optimization (QUBO) subproblems that are solved sequentially within a fixed qubit budget. Thus, circuit width remains independent of network size, with aggregate quantum workload scaling linearly on bounded-degree networks. Evaluation covers eleven IEEE systems from 9 to 300 buses using IBM quantum computing resources, with Gurobi and monolithic QAOA as references. Across all systems, the framework recovers feasible Gurobi-optimal partitions under noise, confirming the resilience of its solution quality. The results further show that the proposed method substantially reduces quantum-resource demand and circuit complexity relative to monolithic QAOA, allowing large islanding problems to be addressed within current hardware limits. The proposed framework provides a feasible and scalable pathway for quantum optimization in large-scale power systems.
summary:
分布式能源资源的日益整合增加了电力系统的可变性和不确定性。在干扰期间，这些影响可能会加剧发电负载不平衡和连锁故障。受控孤岛效应通过将受损的电网划分为相互连接、电力可持续的岛屿来限制其传播。然而，随着网络规模和岛屿数量的增加，经典方法面临着快速增长的计算成本。量子优化为探索这种组合划分空间提供了另一种选择。然而，单片量子公式将所有分配决策编码在一个电路中，导致量子位需求和电路复杂性随着网络规模而扩展。在本研究中，提出了一种量子位限制的顺序分布式量子近似优化算法（QAOA）框架来解决有限量子资源下的相干受控孤岛问题。它将优化表述为边界条件区域二次无约束二元优化 (QUBO) 子问题，这些子问题在固定的量子位预算内顺序求解。

因此，电路宽度保持独立于网络大小，聚合量子工作负载在有界度网络上线性扩展。评估涵盖使用 IBM 量子计算资源、从 9 到 300 条总线的 11 个 IEEE 系统，并以 Gurobi 和单片 QAOA 作为参考。在所有系统中，该框架在噪声下恢复了可行的 Gurobi 最优分区，从而确认了其解决方案质量的弹性。结果进一步表明，相对于单片 QAOA，所提出的方法大大降低了量子资源需求和电路复杂性，从而可以在当前硬件限制内解决大型孤岛问题。所提出的框架为大规模电力系统中的量子优化提供了可行且可扩展的途径。

title: Parity Floors in Quantum Denoisers: A Closed-Form Benchmark for Fixed-Map Denoising Networks
abstract: Fixed quantum feature maps are increasingly inserted into diffusion denoisers, but standard image benchmarks do not reveal which structural constraint limits them. We introduce CoupledPhaseTexture, a torus-diffusion benchmark with analytic heat-kernel noising that separates parity, within-sector approximation, and sample-complexity limitations. For the depth-1 RY+CNOT+Pauli-Z family we prove a containment-free parity floor: all reachable features are even functions of the encoded angles while the sine components of the Bayes denoiser are odd, so the excess risk splits exactly into an inaccessible odd part and a within-sector residual. The first term is an irreducible, noise-scale-resolved lower bound holding for every even feature class, with no containment, linearity, or closedness assumption on the feature class. The obstruction is a property of the noise-conditioned denoising target rather than static representability: the floor is re-derived at each noise scale because the target's parity content changes with noise. The measured excess is dominated by the parity proxy on two distinct priors. Higher-order Z readouts improve the even sector, but entanglement does not lower the floor and re-uploading does not reliably close it. Classical controls confirm the deficit is parity rather than quantumness: a cosine-only bank is floored similarly, while adding the sine sector matches the reference. Among tested constructions, odd readouts and a noise-coupled encoder do not match the sine-carrying classical bank. These results motivate nonclassical data access or feature classes without efficient classical surrogates; they do not establish either as sufficient for quantum advantage.
summary:
固定量子特征图越来越多地插入扩散降噪器中，但标准图像基准并没有揭示哪些结构约束限制了它们。我们引入了 CoupledPhaseTexture，这是一个具有分析热核噪声的环面扩散基准，可分离奇偶校验、扇区内近似和样本复杂性限制。对于深度 1 RY+CNOT+Pauli-Z 系列，我们证明了一个无包含的奇偶校验层：所有可达特征都是编码角度的偶函数，而贝叶斯降噪器的正弦分量是奇数，因此额外的风险恰好分为不可访问的奇数部分和扇区内残差。第一项是每个偶数要素类的不可约的、噪声尺度解析的下界，对要素类没有包含、线性或封闭性假设。障碍物是噪声调节的去噪目标的属性，而不是静态可表示性：在每个噪声尺度上重新导出下限，因为目标的奇偶校验内容随噪声而变化。测量的超额由两个不同先验的奇偶代理主导。

高阶 Z 读数改善了偶数扇区，但纠缠不会降低底线，并且重新上传也不能可靠地关闭底线。经典控制确认赤字是奇偶性的而不是量子性的：纯余弦银行的底线类似，而添加正弦部门则与参考相匹配。在测试的结构中，奇数读数和噪声耦合编码器与正弦承载的经典组不匹配。这些结果激发了非经典数据访问或要素类，而无需有效的经典代理；他们没有证明任何一个都足以产生量子优势。

title: A Minimum-Cardinality Genuinely Unextendible Product Basis in Three Qutrits
abstract: It has remained an open question whether a genuinely unextendible product basis (GUPB) exists. We resolve this problem by constructing an explicit three-qutrit GUPB of cardinality fourteen in the smallest tripartite Hilbert space in which a GUPB can exist. Together with the nonexistence of three-qutrit GUPBs of cardinality less than fourteen, our construction proves that fourteen is the minimum cardinality. A padding procedure further extends the construction to all tripartite systems whose local dimensions are at least three. As applications, the normalized projector onto the thirteen-dimensional orthogonal complement of the three-qutrit GUPB is positive under partial transposition and bound entangled across every bipartition, while the GUPB exhibits strong quantum nonlocality without entanglement.
summary: 是否存在真正不可扩展的产品基础（GUPB）仍然是一个悬而未决的问题。我们通过在 GUPB 可以存在的最小三方希尔伯特空间中构造基数为 14 的显式三四元 GUPB 来解决这个问题。再加上基数小于十四的三四元 GUPB 不存在，我们的构造证明了十四是最小基数。填充程序进一步将构造扩展到局部尺寸至少为三的所有三方系统。作为应用，三量子体 GUPB 的十三维正交补集上的归一化投影在部分转置下是正的，并且在每个二分上都有纠缠，而 GUPB 在没有纠缠的情况下表现出很强的量子非局域性。

title: A Finite-Window Recovery Hierarchy for Local Quantum Memory
abstract: When quantum information initially stored in a local qubit disappears, it need not be lost: it may have moved into nearby degrees of freedom or become inaccessible to shallow local control. We introduce finite-window recoverability as an operational channel benchmark that separates these possibilities. It compares optimal recovery from the target site, recovery by a bounded-depth decoder on a finite window, and the unrestricted optimum for that window. Its operational component, local variational recovery, uses local state preparation, window-local control, and target-qubit Pauli readout to certify recoverable memory beyond the target and quantify how much of the same-window advantage is accessible to shallow control. In a disordered kicked-Ising Floquet chain, a depth-6 decoder on a five-site window realizes $Q^{\mathrm{opt}}_0<Q^{\mathrm{shallow}}_2<Q^{\mathrm{opt}}_2$ across the crossover regime, with positive certified gain for most disorder realizations and substantial shallow-accessibility fractions. The signal differs from target-site persistence and reconstructed coherent-information increments. Positive radius-2 gain also persists when the task is embedded in longer open chains using an independent tensor-network backend. Guided by this hierarchy, we test a carrier-deletion task in which the original target register is reset after the dynamics. A depth-8 decoder repairs the input from a radius-3 surrounding halo with held-out median $F_{\mathrm{avg}}=0.758$, above the single-qubit classical benchmark $2/3$, and outperforms optimal one-, two-, and three-site halo-subwindow counterfactuals. These results establish finite-window recovery as a local-control benchmark for off-site quantum memory, diagnosing both where local quantum information remains and whether bounded-depth control can refocus it.
summary:
当最初存储在局部量子位中的量子信息消失时，它不一定会丢失：它可能已经进入附近的自由度或变得无法进行浅层局部控制。我们引入有限窗口可恢复性作为区分这些可能性的操作通道基准。它比较了目标站点的最佳恢复、有限深度解码器在有限窗口上的恢复以及该窗口的无限制最佳恢复。其操作组件局部变分恢复使用局部状态准备、窗口局部控制和目标量子位泡利读出来验证超出目标的可恢复内存，并量化浅层控制可获取多少相同窗口优势。在无序的 kicked-Ising Floquet 链中，五站点窗口上的深度 6 解码器在交叉机制中实现了 $Q^{\mathrm{opt}}_0<Q^{\mathrm{shallow}}_2<Q^{\mathrm{opt}}_2$，对于大多数无序实现和大量的浅可访问性分数具有正认证增益。该信号不同于目标站点持久性和重建的相干信息增量。

当使用独立张量网络后端将任务嵌入到较长的开放链中时，正半径 2 增益也会持续存在。在这个层次结构的指导下，我们测试了一个载波删除任务，其中原始目标寄存器在动态之后被重置。深度 8 解码器修复来自半径 3 周围光环的输入，保留中值 $F_{\mathrm{avg}}=0.758$，高于单量子位经典基准 $2/3$，并且优于最佳的一、二和三位点光环子窗口反事实。这些结果将有限窗口恢复建立为场外量子存储器的本地控制基准，诊断本地量子信息的保留位置以及有界深度控制是否可以重新聚焦它。

title: Sector-resolved non-Bloch topology and nonlocal entanglement dynamics in a bond-dissipative Kitaev chain
abstract: A core characteristic of dissipative non-Hermitian topology is that the relaxation dynamics tracks the non-Bloch bulk-boundary correspondence, rendering an algebraic decay in the gapless regime and an exponential falloff in the gapped phase, so that local observables directly diagnose the topology. We show that this correspondence breaks down in a dissipative topological superconductor, where the local observables turn blind to the very topology they are expected to decipher. Via a bond-dissipative dimerized Kitaev chain in a third-quantized rapidity-matrix formulation, we find that at zero chemical potential the Majorana rapidity matrix decomposes into two independent non-Hermitian sectors, each with its own generalized Brillouin zone and non-Bloch winding number, thereby revealing a sector-resolved non-Bloch bulk-boundary correspondence. The local density is a cross-sector covariance and relaxes at the sum of the two sector rates, so it remains sector-blind even when one sector is gapless and topological. For balanced gain and loss, the finite-time zero events of the entanglement spectrum under purely periodic-boundary Lindblad evolution recover this hidden edge content sector by sector, serving as a dynamical invariant that returns the open-boundary edge rapidities without physically opening the chain.
summary:
耗散非厄米拓扑的核心特征是弛豫动力学跟踪非布洛赫体边界对应，在无间隙状态下呈现代数衰减，在有间隙状态下呈现指数衰减，从而使局部可观测量直接诊断拓扑。我们证明，这种对应关系在耗散拓扑超导体中被破坏，局部可观测量对他们期望破译的拓扑视而不见。通过第三量子化速度矩阵公式中的键耗散二聚基塔耶夫链，我们发现在零化学势下，马约拉纳速度矩阵分解为两个独立的非厄米扇区，每个扇区都有自己的广义布里渊区和非布洛赫缠绕数，从而揭示了扇区解析的非布洛赫体边界对应关系。局部密度是一种跨扇区协方差，并在两个扇区速率之和处松弛，因此即使一个扇区是无间隙和拓扑的，它仍然是扇区盲的。

为了平衡增益和损失，纯周期边界林德布拉德演化下的纠缠谱的有限时间零事件逐个扇区地恢复这个隐藏的边缘内容，作为一个动态不变量，在不物理打开链的情况下返回开放边界边缘速度。

title: Hybrid HPC-Quantum Simulations: DFT-Quantum Embedding for Molecular Systems
abstract: Scientific simulations demand methods combining scalability with predictive accuracy. Density Functional Theory (DFT) on High-Performance Computing (HPC) enables large-scale electronic-structure simulations but is limited by approximations affecting strongly correlated systems and band-gap predictions. Quantum computing offers a pathway to address this, though current Noisy Intermediate-Scale Quantum (NISQ) hardware remains constrained by qubit resources, noise, and execution cost. This work presents a hybrid DFT-Quantum Embedding (QDFT) framework integrating classical HPC-based DFT with a quantum electronic-structure solver. Large systems are partitioned to isolate a chemically relevant active space, treated via the Variational Quantum Eigensolver (VQE), while the remaining degrees of freedom are described by DFT. The framework incorporates active-space selection, embedded Hamiltonian construction, symmetry preservation, operator mapping, self-consistent density updating, and modular classical-quantum coupling. We focus on noiseless quantum simulation to systematically evaluate accuracy, convergence, active-space dependence, computational cost, and HPC scalability without hardware noise. Detailed profiling identifies computational bottlenecks and highlights limitations of CPU-based quantum simulation. A QPU runtime-estimation methodology is additionally developed to assess execution requirements on actual quantum hardware. Results demonstrate quantum embedding's potential to improve selected electronic-structure properties while retaining classical HPC's scalability. Noisy quantum simulation and QPU execution remain key future directions, providing a pathway toward practical, scalable HPC-quantum hybrid simulations as hardware matures.
summary:
科学模拟需要将可扩展性与预测准确性相结合的方法。高性能计算 (HPC) 上的密度泛函理论 (DFT) 可实现大规模电子结构模拟，但受到影响强相关系统和带隙预测的近似的限制。量子计算提供了解决这个问题的途径，尽管当前的嘈杂中级量子（NISQ）硬件仍然受到量子位资源、噪声和执行成本的限制。这项工作提出了一种混合 DFT-量子嵌入 (QDFT) 框架，将经典的基于 HPC 的 DFT 与量子电子结构求解器集成在一起。大型系统被分区以隔离化学相关的活动空间，并通过变分量子本征解算器 (VQE) 进行处理，而其余自由度则通过 DFT 进行描述。该框架结合了主动空间选择、嵌入式哈密顿构造、对称性保持、算子映射、自洽密度更新和模块化经典量子耦合。

我们专注于无噪声量子模拟，在没有硬件噪声的情况下系统地评估准确性、收敛性、活动空间依赖性、计算成本和 HPC 可扩展性。详细的分析可识别计算瓶颈并突出基于 CPU 的量子模拟的局限性。另外还开发了 QPU 运行时估计方法来评估实际量子硬件上的执行要求。结果表明，量子嵌入有潜力改善选定的电子结构特性，同时保留经典 HPC 的可扩展性。噪声量子模拟和 QPU 执行仍然是未来的关键方向，随着硬件的成熟，为实用、可扩展的 HPC-量子混合模拟提供了一条途径。

title: Time-ordered free energy in correlated quantum systems: An agentic approach
abstract: How much work can an agent extract from a temporal sequence of quantum states when it can only operate online under causal constraints---deciding which energy extraction method to use with knowledge of what it has observed before? Here, we study this problem in the context of quantum state sequences that are potentially non-Markovian---generated by some underlying hidden Markov machine that the agent cannot observe. Using techniques from dynamic programming and computational mechanics, we present a method to identify the provably optimal agent strategy, with time complexity that scales linearly with sequence length. This motivates us to introduce the maximum work such agents can extract---time-ordered free energy(TOFE)---as a fundamental measure of free energy available in a temporally correlated quantum system subject to causal considerations.
summary: 当智能体只能在因果约束下在线运行时，它可以从量子态的时间序列中提取多少功——根据之前观察到的知识来决定使用哪种能量提取方法？在这里，我们在量子状态序列的背景下研究这个问题，这些量子状态序列可能是非马尔可夫的——由代理无法观察到的一些底层隐藏马尔可夫机生成。使用动态编程和计算力学的技术，我们提出了一种方法来识别可证明的最佳代理策略，其时间复杂度随序列长度线性扩展。这促使我们引入此类代理可以提取的最大功——时间有序自由能（TOFE）——作为在考虑因果关系的时间相关量子系统中可用的自由能的基本度量。

title: Geometry versus excitation sector in the decoherence of asymmetric $N$-qubit $W$ states
abstract: We investigate how network geometry and excitation sector separately control pairwise entanglement decay in asymmetric multipartite $W$ states. To disentangle these effects, we introduce an analytically tractable $N$-qubit generalization of the asymmetric Lohmayer geometry and its complementary-excitation partner, yielding inequivalent vertex-base (VB) and base-base (BB) pair classes that can be compared directly with symmetric $W$-state references. We derive closed-form concurrence dynamics under representative one-sided noise models and find that, within either excitation sector, the VB concurrence has exactly the same noise dependence as the corresponding symmetric reference, preserving a noise-independent proportional advantage wherever both remain entangled. The amplitude-damping reordering previously identified for the three-qubit Lohmayer state is therefore a cross-sector effect rather than an intrinsic fragility of the VB geometry. In contrast, the BB pair exhibits a genuine same-sector structural fragility, with lower entanglement-sudden-death thresholds than the VB pair under depolarizing noise and, in the $(N-1)$-excitation sector, under amplitude damping. The results establish network geometry, excitation sector, and noise symmetry as distinct ingredients governing pairwise entanglement robustness in asymmetric quantum networks.
summary:
我们研究网络几何和激励扇区如何分别控制不对称多部分 $W$ 状态中的成对纠缠衰减。为了解开这些影响，我们引入了非对称 Lohmayer 几何及其互补激发伙伴的可分析处理的 $N$ 量子位概括，产生不等价的顶点基（VB）和基基（BB）对类，可以直接与对称 $W$ 状态参考进行比较。我们在代表性的单侧噪声模型下推导了封闭形式并发动力学，并发现，在任一激励扇区内，VB并发具有与相应对称参考完全相同的噪声依赖性，在两者保持纠缠的情况下保持与噪声无关的比例优势。因此，之前为三量子位 Lohmayer 态确定的振幅阻尼重排序是一种跨部门效应，而不是 VB 几何结构的内在脆弱性。相比之下，BB 对表现出真正的同扇区结构脆弱性，在去极化噪声下以及在 $(N-1)$ 激励扇区中，在振幅阻尼下，其纠缠猝死阈值低于 VB 对。

结果将网络几何形状、激发扇区和噪声对称性确定为控制不对称量子网络中成对纠缠鲁棒性的不同成分。

title: Always-on, highly efficient microwave photon detector based on a superconducting artificial molecule
abstract: Efficient detection of single microwave photons is a key capability for emerging quantum technologies. Yet, it remains far less developed than its optical domain counterpart. Realizing detectors that simultaneously achieve high efficiency, low dark counts, and continuous operation has proved challenging. Existing detectors operate cyclically, forcing a trade-off between efficiency and duty cycle. Here, we demonstrate a continuously operated microwave single-photon detector based on a superconducting artificial molecule. In our scheme, an incoming photon is captured by a bright state of the molecule and then transferred to a long-lived dark state via a driven-dissipative process. Photon ``clicks'' are revealed as quantum jumps in the continuously monitored dark state. We observe a cyclic detection efficiency of $0.73$, and a continuous detection efficiency of $0.47$ over a $5\,\mathrm{MHz}$ instantaneous bandwidth, with a $1\,\mu\mathrm{s}$ temporal resolution and a $15\,\mu\mathrm{s}$ dead time. By overcoming the trade-off between efficiency and duty cycle, this approach establishes continuous microwave photon detection for quantum sensing, quantum thermodynamics, and fundamental physics.
summary:
有效检测单个微波光子是新兴量子技术的关键能力。然而，它仍然远不及光学领域的同类产品。事实证明，实现同时实现高效率、低暗计数和连续操作的探测器具有挑战性。现有探测器循环运行，迫使在效率和占空比之间进行权衡。在这里，我们展示了一种基于超导人造分子的连续运行的微波单光子探测器。在我们的方案中，入射光子被分子的亮态捕获，然后通过驱动耗散过程转移到长寿命的暗态。光子“咔哒声”被揭示为连续监测的暗态中的量子跃迁。我们观察到，在 $5\,\mathrm{MHz}$ 瞬时带宽上，循环检测效率为 $0.73$，连续检测效率为 $0.47$，时间分辨率为 $1\,\mu\mathrm{s}$，死区时间为 $15\,\mu\mathrm{s}$。

通过克服效率和占空比之间的权衡，该方法为量子传感、量子热力学和基础物理学建立了连续的微波光子检测。

title: Robust controlled-Z gate for Rydberg atoms based on level-crossing-free echoing rapid adiabatic passage
abstract: We propose a controlled-Z gate scheme for Rydberg atoms based on level-crossing-free echoing rapid adiabatic population transfer. We design antisymmetric Rabi frequency pulses and symmetric detuning pulses, enabling the system to completely avoid level-crossing points throughout the evolution, and the dynamical phase is naturally eliminated by the time-reversal symmetry of the double-pulse sequence. We incorporate dissipative effects through the Lindblad master equation. The numerical simulation yields a two-qubit CZ gate fidelity of 0.9999. When the Rabi-frequency fluctuation is within $\pm 2\%$, and the detuning offset is within $\pm 1\%$, the fidelity can still remain above 0.999. Under the same dissipative model, the three-qubit CCZ gate achieves a fidelity of 0.999. When a single-parameter fluctuation does not exceed $\pm 3\%$, the fidelity is always higher than 0.997. Our scheme requires no laser phase jumps or fast switching operations. The zero-area pulse structure suppresses first-order intensity noise, and the symmetric double-pulse sequence avoids spatially resolved laser switching, making it suitable for parallel gate operations in large-scale neutral-atom arrays.
summary: 我们提出了一种基于无电平交叉回声快速绝热布居转移的里德伯原子受控 Z 门方案。我们设计了反对称的拉比频率脉冲和对称的失谐脉冲，使系统在整个演化过程中完全避免了电平交叉点，并且双脉冲序列的时间反转对称性自然消除了动态相位。我们通过 Lindblad 主方程合并耗散效应。数值模拟产生的两个量子位 CZ 门保真度为 0.9999。当拉比频率波动在$\pm 2\%$以内，失谐偏移在$\pm 1\%$以内时，保真度仍能保持在0.999以上。在相同的耗散模型下，三量子位 CCZ 门的保真度达到 0.999。当单参数波动不超过$\pm 3\%$时，保真度始终高于0.997。我们的方案不需要激光相位跳跃或快速切换操作。零面积脉冲结构抑制一阶强度噪声，对称双脉冲序列避免空间分辨激光切换，使其适合大规模中性原子阵列中的并行门操作。

title: Controlled dynamics of a multi-component discrete-time quantum walker
abstract: We investigate a discrete-time quantum walk of a three-component quantum particle on a one-dimensional lattice. As coin operators, we employ parameterized rotations generated by the Gell-Mann matrices, which enable systematic tuning of the couplings between the internal components. We analyze how these couplings influence and control the dynamics by systematically exploring the position-space probability distribution across a broad region of the parameter space. To quantify the impact of different inter-component couplings, we further examine the ratio of the mean position to the variance in each half of the lattice. Our results indicates that the system supports a rich variety of transport regimes, ranging from nearly symmetric, rapidly spreading walks to strongly anisotropic dynamics with partial localization. This framework thus provides a new avenue for engineering targeted spreading and trapping behavior in multicomponent discrete-time quantum walks.
summary: 我们研究一维晶格上三分量量子粒子的离散时间量子行走。作为硬币算子，我们采用盖尔曼矩阵生成的参数化旋转，这使得能够系统地调整内部组件之间的耦合。我们通过系统地探索参数空间广泛区域的位置空间概率分布来分析这些耦合如何影响和控制动力学。为了量化不同组件间耦合的影响，我们进一步检查了晶格每一半中平均位置与方差的比率。我们的结果表明，该系统支持丰富多样的传输机制，从近对称、快速传播的行走到具有部分局部化的强各向异性动力学。因此，该框架为设计多分量离散时间量子行走中的目标扩散和捕获行为提供了新途径。

title: Counter-examples for Tensorization Property of Strong Data Processing Inequality for Quantum Divergences
abstract: The data processing inequality is a fundamental property that describes the loss of information through noisy channels. A more refined description is characterized by the strong data processing inequality (SDPI). In classical information theory, the tensorization of strong data processing inequality holds for a whole family of $f$-divergences. However, its quantum counterpart is less known. The tensorization of SDPI was shown only for some special cases previously, and the general understanding about the tensorization property of SDPI for quantum divergences remains open. In this work, we report two negative results: the tensorization property fails for certain quantum chi-square divergences, and it also does not hold for the quantum relative entropy.
summary: 数据处理不等式是描述通过噪声通道丢失信息的基本属性。更精细的描述以强数据处理不等式（SDPI）为特征。在经典信息论中，强数据处理不等式的张量化适用于整个 $f$ 散度家族。然而，它的量子对应物却鲜为人知。之前仅针对一些特殊情况展示了 SDPI 的张量化，并且关于量子散度的 SDPI 张量化性质的一般理解仍然是开放的。在这项工作中，我们报告了两个负面结果：张量化性质对于某些量子卡方散度失败，并且对于量子相对熵也不成立。

title: Heat transport in driven quantum systems: Comparison between the Floquet-Redfield equation and the master equation in the instantaneous eigenbasis
abstract: We provide a comprehensive study of heat transport in periodically driven quantum systems using a combination of master equation and Floquet approach. We give exact results (within the weak coupling Redfield theory, with no Markovian or secular approximations) and compare them with alternative approaches involving further approximations. Numerical and analytical results obtained in their appropriate driving regimes are provided for the driven spin boson-model. The adiabatic regime, which is relevant to thermal machines, is discussed.
summary: 我们结合主方程和 Floquet 方法对周期性驱动的量子系统中的热传输进行了全面的研究。我们给出了精确的结果（在弱耦合雷德菲尔德理论中，没有马尔可夫或世俗近似），并将它们与涉及进一步近似的替代方法进行比较。为驱动自旋玻色子模型提供了在适当的驱动方式下获得的数值和分析结果。讨论了与热机相关的绝热状态。

title: Universal magic state concentration
abstract: Magic plays a dual role in quantum computation: it promotes stabilizer dynamics from efficient classical simulability to universality, but it presents a central challenge for fault tolerance, since non-stabilizer operations are harder to protect against noise. Magic state distillation addresses this issue; however, existing protocols typically assume prior structure in the input, such as proximity to the target or a specified noise model. Here we introduce universal magic state concentration: a fixed stabilizer protocol that converts a few copies of an unknown pure non-stabilizer qubit state into an exact target magic state. Motivated by the obstruction to exact $T$-state concentration, we show that $\mathrm{CCZ}$ states behave fundamentally differently. Six input copies are necessary and sufficient to distill one exact $\mathrm{CCZ}$ state, with an optimal success probability determined by the linearized order-three stabilizer Rényi entropy $M^{\mathrm{lin}}_3$. Beyond this, we show that $M^{\mathrm{lin}}_3$ governs the optimal state dependence of any protocol up to nine input copies, and we showcase an eight-copy protocol with improved success probability. Furthermore, block repetition of our protocols yields asymptotic distillation rates that achieve optimal scaling up to logarithmic factors. As a corollary, any unknown pure qubit magic state suffices for universal quantum computation via exact $\mathrm{CCZ}$ injection. Together, these results identify the stabilizer Rényi entropy as a fundamental operational quantity in magic state distillation.
summary:
Magic 在量子计算中扮演着双重角色：它促进了稳定器动力学从高效的经典可模拟性到通用性，但它对容错提出了核心挑战，因为非稳定器操作更难防止噪声。魔态蒸馏解决了这个问题；然而，现有协议通常假设输入中存在先前的结构，例如接近目标或指定的噪声模型。在这里，我们介绍通用魔法状态集中：一种固定稳定器协议，可将未知的纯非稳定器量子位状态的一些副本转换为精确的目标魔法状态。由于阻碍了精确的 $T$ 状态集中，我们表明 $\mathrm{CCZ}$ 状态的行为根本不同。六个输入副本对于提取一个精确的 $\mathrm{CCZ}$ 状态是必要且充分的，最佳成功概率由线性化三阶稳定器 Rényi 熵 $M^{\mathrm{lin}}_3$ 确定。除此之外，我们表明 $M^{\mathrm{lin}}_3$ 控制最多九个输入副本的任何协议的最佳状态依赖性，并且我们展示了具有更高成功概率的八副本协议。

此外，我们的协议的块重复产生渐近蒸馏速率，实现对数因子的最佳缩放。作为推论，任何未知的纯量子位魔法状态都足以通过精确的 $\mathrm{CCZ}$ 注入进行通用量子计算。总之，这些结果将稳定器 Rényi 熵确定为魔态蒸馏中的基本运算量。

title: Field-Widened Multimode Interferometer with Long Time-Bin Delay Using a Multi-Pass Herriott Cell
abstract: Interference of optical signals in free-space channels requires optical receivers to support many spatial modes due to atmospheric turbulence, typically necessitating adaptive optics systems. Field-widened interferometers offer a passive alternative, making them particularly attractive for time-bin encoded signals with delays on the order of one nanosecond. Here, we demonstrate a field-widened, multimode interferometer design that achieves a high interference visibility for spatially multimode beams with large time bin separations. The interference of the multimode beams is enabled using a multi-pass Herriott cell that enables a very long path separation with a small form-factor. The design is tested using both numerical ray-tracing simulations and proof-of-principle demonstrations. We create a prototype interferometer with a path length difference of 12ns and determine that it maintains a high interference visibility with a large field-of-view of $0.4^{\circ}$.
summary: 由于大气湍流，自由空间通道中光信号的干扰要求光接收器支持多种空间模式，通常需要自适应光学系统。视场加宽干涉仪提供了一种无源替代方案，使其对于延迟约为一纳秒的时间仓编码信号特别有吸引力。在这里，我们演示了一种扩视场多模干涉仪设计，该设计可实现具有大时间间隔间隔的空间多模光束的高干涉可见度。多模光束的干涉是通过使用多通道赫里奥特盒实现的，该盒能够以小形状因数实现很长的路径间隔。该设计通过数值光线追踪模拟和原理验证演示进行了测试。我们创建了一个路径长度差为 12ns 的原型干涉仪，并确定它保持了高干涉可见性和 $0.4^{\circ}$ 的大视场。

title: Strong unitary designs in optimal depth and space
abstract: Unitary designs provide finite-moment approximations to Haar-random unitaries, with wide-ranging applications across physics and quantum information, from scrambling and black-hole dynamics to foundational primitives in quantum algorithms. Strong unitary designs capture a more demanding operational notion of approximation, requiring indistinguishability from Haar randomness even for quantum algorithms that may access a unitary not only in the forward direction, but also through its inverse, transpose, and complex conjugate. Motivated by the physical requirement that scrambling arise within the system itself, Schuster, Ma, Lombardi, Brandão, and Huang ( arXiv:2509.26310 ) left open whether strong unitary designs can be generated in logarithmic depth using only the system qubits. For every fixed design order $k$ and measurable-error tolerance, we construct strong approximate unitary $k$-designs in optimal $\Theta(\log n)$ all-to-all circuit depth using only the $n$ original system qubits. Our new ingredient is a logarithmic-depth Pauli-mixing bound for the perfect-matching ensemble, whose layers pair the qubits uniformly at random and apply independent random two-qubit gates. This bound controls the mixed forward-reverse two-query case, which we combine with existing design and gluing results to obtain strong unitary designs of arbitrary fixed order.
summary:
酉设计为 Haar 随机酉提供了有限矩近似，在物理和量子信息领域有着广泛的应用，从加扰和黑洞动力学到量子算法中的基础原语。强酉设计捕获了更苛刻的近似操作概念，即使对于不仅可以在前向而且可以通过其逆、转置和复共轭访问酉的量子算法，也需要与哈尔随机性不可区分。出于系统本身内部出现置乱的物理要求，Schuster、Ma、Lombardi、Brandão 和 Huang (arXiv:2509.26310) 对于是否可以仅使用系统量子位以对数深度生成强单一设计持开放态度。对于每个固定的设计顺序 $k$ 和可测量的误差容限，我们仅使用 $n$ 原始系统量子位在最佳 $\Theta(\log n)$ 全电路深度中构建强近似单一 $k$ 设计。我们的新成分是完美匹配系综的对数深度泡利混合界限，其层随机均匀地配对量子位并应用独立的随机双量子位门。

该界限控制混合正向-反向两个查询的情况，我们将其与现有设计和粘合结果相结合，以获得任意固定顺序的强大单一设计。

title: Quantum correlations and Basis-Independent Coherence Distribution in Two Gravitational Cat States
abstract: We study the distribution of quantum correlations and basis-independent coherence in a pair of massive particles confined in a double-well potential and coupled through their mutual Newtonian gravitational interaction. Non-classical correlations are characterized using Bures distance of entanglement and quantum discord, while coherence is quantified through the square root of the quantum Jensen--Shannon divergence (QJSD) from the maximally mixed state, yielding a measure that is invariant under arbitrary unitary transformations and is therefore genuinely basis-independent. The total coherence $C_T$ decomposes into two operationally distinct contributions: the collective coherence $C_C$, which captures quantum correlations between the two subsystems, and the localized coherence $C_L$, which captures the intrinsic quantum coherence of each individual subsystem. We analyze how temperature $T$, the gravitational coupling $\Delta$, and the single-particle energy scale $w$ govern the redistribution of coherence between its collective and localized components. Our results show that $C_L$ is more robust against thermal fluctuations than $C_C$, and that increasing $\Delta$ preferentially enhances collective coherence by strengthening gravitationally induced inter-particle correlations.
summary:
我们研究了一对被限制在双阱势中并通过相互牛顿引力相互作用耦合的大质量粒子中的量子相关性和与基无关的相干性的分布。非经典相关性使用纠缠和量子不和谐的 Bures 距离来表征，而相干性则通过来自最大混合态的量子詹森-香农散度 (QJSD) 的平方根来量化，产生在任意酉变换下不变的度量，因此是真正与基无关的。总相干性 $C_T$ 分解为两个操作上不同的贡献：集体相干性 $C_C$（捕获两个子系统之间的量子相关性）和局部相干性 $C_L$（捕获每个单独子系统的内在量子相干性）。我们分析温度 $T$、引力耦合 $\Delta$ 和单粒子能量尺度 $w$ 如何控制其集体和局部组件之间相干性的重新分布。

我们的结果表明，$C_L$ 比 $C_C$ 更能抵抗热波动，并且增加 $\Delta$ 通过加强引力引起的粒子间相关性优先增强集体相干性。

title: Ambient unitaries don't enable shallow group designs
abstract: Characterising the efficiency with which designs over various subsets of the unitary group may be constructed is an important goal of quantum information theory. While it is now known that approximate unitary designs can be realised in depth logarithmic in the system size, it has recently been shown that ensembles of local nearest-neighbour sublinear-depth one-dimensional circuits over the matchgate, orthogonal, and symplectic groups cannot form approximate 2-designs over their parent groups; similarly, sublinear-depth ensembles of Cliffords cannot form a Clifford 4-design. In this note we show that this remarkable exponential separation is not merely an artefact of restricting to ensembles consisting of unitaries from the subgroups themselves, but rather that no ensemble of local nearest-neighbour sublinear-depth unitaries can realise approximate designs in the aforementioned cases, even when employing "ambient" unitaries from beyond the subgroup itself (possibly acting on ancilla qubits). This implies that various natural tomography and benchmarking schemes which involves sampling from these groups suffer from a dramatic circuit depth overhead compared to similar protocols which involve sampling from the full unitary group. We additionally conclude that, in all of the above cases, the known linear-depth design constructions are up to constant factors optimal.
summary:
表征酉群的各个子集的设计的构建效率是量子信息论的一个重要目标。虽然现在已知近似酉设计可以在系统尺寸的深度对数上实现，但最近的研究表明，匹配门、正交和辛群上的局部最近邻亚线性深度一维电路的集合不能在其父群上形成近似2-设计；类似地，Cliffords 的次线性深度系综不能形成 Clifford 4 设计。在本文中，我们表明，这种显着的指数分离不仅仅是限制由子群本身的酉组成的系综的人为因素，而且没有任何局部最近邻亚线性深度酉系的系综可以在上述情况下实现近似设计，即使使用来自子群本身之外的“环境”酉系（可能作用于辅助量子位）。

这意味着与涉及从完整单一组进行采样的类似协议相比，涉及从这些组进行采样的各种自然断层扫描和基准测试方案会遭受巨大的电路深度开销。我们还得出结论，在所有上述情况下，已知的线性深度设计结构均达到最佳常数因子。

title: Quantum simulation of non-Markovian dynamical systems
abstract: Existing quantum algorithms for simulating dynamical systems -- from Hamiltonian simulation to linear and nonlinear differential equations solvers -- simulate Markovian dynamics, in which the system's future evolution depends solely on its current state. We turn our attention to developing quantum algorithms for non-Markovian dynamical systems where the system's future evolution depends on its past history and thus has memory. Specifically, we develop efficient algorithms for linear Volterra integro-differential equations (VIDEs) with a convolution memory kernel that output a quantum state encoding the state description over a time interval or at a particular time. Given efficient circuits for the problem inputs, our algorithms achieve an exponential speedup in system size over existing classical algorithms. We develop an algorithm for general kernels assuming that $\textsf{M} < 1$, where $\textsf{M}$ characterizes the strength of the memory term relative to the dissipation of the Markovian part of the dynamics. We complement this with lower bounds for general-kernel VIDEs when $\textsf{M} \geq 1$, showing that the problem becomes intractable for a family of systems. However, by specializing to structured kernels which admit concise decompositions over exponentials, we develop efficient quantum algorithms even when $\textsf M \geq 1$ by converting the VIDE into a larger set of ODEs, a procedure which we call Markovianization. As an application of the overall framework, we discuss the Mori-Zwanzig formalism used in open quantum systems and fluid dynamics. Overall, our results expand the range of dynamical systems that quantum computers can simulate efficiently.
summary:
现有的用于模拟动力系统的量子算法——从哈密顿模拟到线性和非线性微分方程求解器——模拟马尔可夫动力学，其中系统的未来演化仅取决于其当前状态。我们将注意力转向开发非马尔可夫动力系统的量子算法，其中系统的未来演化取决于其过去的历史，因此具有记忆。具体来说，我们为线性 Volterra 积分微分方程 (VIDE) 开发了有效的算法，该算法具有卷积内存内核，可输出编码一段时间间隔或特定时间的状态描述的量子状态。考虑到问题输入的有效电路，我们的算法比现有的经典算法在系统规模上实现了指数级的加速。我们为通用内核开发了一种算法，假设 $\textsf{M} < 1$，其中 $\textsf{M}$ 表征记忆项相对于动态马尔可夫部分耗散的强度。当 $\textsf{M} \geq 1$ 时，我们用通用内核 VIDE 的下限来补充这一点，表明该问题对于一系列系统来说变得棘手。

然而，通过专门研究允许对指数进行简明分解的结构化内核，即使在 $\textsf M \geq 1$ 时，我们也可以通过将 VIDE 转换为更大的 ODE 集（我们称之为马尔可夫化）来开发高效的量子算法。作为整体框架的应用，我们讨论了开放量子系统和流体动力学中使用的 Mori-Zwanzig 形式主义。总的来说，我们的结果扩大了量子计算机可以有效模拟的动力系统的范围。

title: Every PPT channel has finite entanglement-breaking index
abstract: We prove that every PPT linear map has finite entanglement-breaking index, thereby establishing the eventual entanglement-breaking property of PPT channels in full generality. Furthermore, by utilizing completely positive maps with low entanglement dimensionality, we show that a large family of PPT maps, which strictly containing the class of 2-superpositive maps, has entanglement-breaking index bounded above by 3, uniformly in the dimension. In particular, these results provide strong evidence that the PPT-cubed conjecture may hold in full generality.
summary: 我们证明了每个 PPT 线性映射都具有有限的纠缠破坏指数，从而完全通用地建立了 PPT 通道的最终纠缠破坏属性。此外，通过利用具有低纠缠维数的完全正图，我们证明了严格包含2-超正图类的一大族PPT图，其纠缠破坏指数以3为界，在维度上是一致的。特别是，这些结果提供了强有力的证据，证明 PPT 立方猜想可能具有完全的普遍性。
